[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Parx''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who worked for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Rufus Trammel]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Parx traveled to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]], where Trammel tasked him with leading a group of poachers, to capture the [[Dorumaan leviathan]] [[Jessel]]. They captured the creature, but while they attempted to load it onto a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], Parx and the poachers were attacked by the [[heroes of Cularin]].
